lines.en: Creeping like silk, silent as the night.
Silken strands wrap, eerie and fearsome.
Eight legs move, silent and light.
Nightly ghost, creeping in dreams.

lines.zh: 阳光下隐形，阴暗处现身。
lines.en: Invisible in sunlight, appearing in shadows.
Spinning webs, catching Ghost Slayers.
Chasing foes, endless darkness follows.
Celebrating under moonlight, ghostly dances boundless.
Beware, Ghost Slayers, I seek my prey.
Hiding in sunlight, ghostly shadows flit.
She walks a thread across the treetops.
Eight thin legs show beneath her hem.
She slides down the trunk along her web.

lines.zh: 丝线在她指间绷紧又松。
lines.en: The thread tightens and slackens between her fingers.

lines.zh: 她贴着阴影，走向林深处。
lines.en: She keeps to the shade, heading deeper in.
Her steps are as light as falling leaves.
Weaving webs, quietly awaiting.
Sitting in the web, quietly observing.
Silent as night, without a sound.
Waiting for the right moment, striking silently.
Steady as stone, waiting for prey.
Silent night, lurking in wait.
Quietly resting, waiting to hunt.
Observing, waiting for the right chance.
Wandering quietly, waiting for prey.
Waiting for dawn, avoiding the light.
She sits at her web's center, tidying her hair.

lines.zh: 丝线随她的呼吸微微颤。
lines.en: The threads tremble with her breathing.
Observing you, Ghost Slayer.
In my sight, don’t move.
Staring at you, Ghost Slayer.
In my sight, you cannot escape.
Noticing you, Ghost Slayer warrior.

lines.zh: 你在我眼中，鬼杀队之徒。
lines.en: In my eyes, Ghost Slayer scum.

lines.zh: 你在我注视下，动弹不得。
lines.en: Under my gaze, you cannot move.
Staring at you, Ghost Slayer.

lines.zh: 你在我视线里，别妄想跑。
lines.en: In my sight, don’t try to run.
Staring at you, Ghost Slayer enemy.
Weak now, kill me fast!
I can't hold on anymore!
Please, don't kill me!
Brother, my thread snapped.
Move or I'm done for!
Don't come any closer!
Have mercy on me!
Don't kill me, please!
Save me, I want to live!

lines.zh: 快救我，别放我死在这里！
lines.en: Help me, don't let me die here!
Taste this delicacy, don't you drool?

lines.zh: Rui Sister来了，来尝尝我的美味吧！
lines.en: Rui Sister is here, come and taste my delicacy!
Such a delicious treat, enjoy it!

lines.zh: 那田蜘蛛山的丝，先缠住你。
lines.en: Mt. Natagumo silk wraps you first.
Try my food, you must!

lines.zh: 品尝我的美食，享受我的毒液！
lines.en: Savor my cuisine, relish my venom!

lines.zh: Rui Sister的美食，你不想试试？
lines.en: Rui Sister's cuisine, you don't want to try?
My venom, taste it!
Come, savor my gift!
My venom, you cannot resist!

lines.zh: 小心，我的网会让你化为虚无！
lines.en: Beware, my web will make you vanish!

lines.zh: 撞上我的网，就别想离开！
lines.en: Hit my web, and you're trapped!
My web, none escape it!

lines.zh: 小心，我的丝线会束缚你！
lines.en: Beware, my silk will bind you!

lines.zh: 别靠近，我的网在等待你！
lines.en: Don't come near, my web awaits!
My web, none escape!
Beware my web, it causes pain!
My web, it paralyzes you!
My web, none can break!
Beware, my web is deadly!

lines.zh: 来吧，我的爱人，一起繁衍！
lines.en: Come, my lover, let's procreate!

lines.zh: 求爱吧，我的伴侣，一起生活！
lines.en: Court me, my partner, live with me!

lines.zh: 我的爱侣，一起创造未来！
lines.en: My mate, let's create the future!

lines.zh: 我的爱人，一起迎接明天！
lines.en: My love, together face tomorrow!

lines.zh: 求爱吧，我的伴侣，共享生命！
lines.en: Court me, my partner, share life!

lines.zh: 我的爱人，一起度过黑夜！
lines.en: My love, together through the night!

lines.zh: 求爱吧，我的爱人，一起飞翔！
lines.en: Court me, my lover, fly with me!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，一起享受夜晚！
lines.en: My partner, enjoy the night with me!

lines.zh: 我的爱人，一起征服黑暗！
lines.en: My love, together conquer the darkness!

lines.zh: 我的伴侣，一起创造奇迹！
lines.en: My partner, let's create miracles!
Weaving webs to catch the Ghost Slayers!
Feast on fresh, tender flesh!
This land is mine!
Away from the sun, I need my nap!
Seeking prey, Ghost Slayer!
My venom causes suffering!
Nata Spider Mountain is my home!
Hold him tight, don't let him go!

lines.zh: 丝囊里还剩最后一缕丝。
lines.en: One last strand left in my spinneret.
Capture the Ghost Slayers for me!
Prey detected, prepare to attack!
Feel the spider venom, human!
My silk binds all!
Closer now, bite him!

lines.zh: 杀死魂杀队，净化这片土地！
lines.en: Kill the Ghost Slayers, purify the land!
Watch out for my attack, human!
Don't let me wait for the night, human!
You can't escape, Ghost Slayer!
My blood magic, unmatched!

lines.zh: 吞噬你的灵魂，我的猎物！
lines.en: Devour your soul, my prey!

lines.zh: 她闻到了鬼杀队的汗味。
lines.en: She smells the sweat of a Demon Slayer.
In the tree shadow her eyes light up.
Track the prey, do not falter!
You can't hide from me, Ghost Slayer!
Come closer, I want to bite you!
My web, your end!
No one leaves the spider mountain.
Remember this moment, human!
My silk, your tomb!

lines.zh: 丝线已经缠住你的脚踝。
lines.en: My threads are already wrapped around your ankle.
Your life, my silk!
You will always belong to me!
Threads draw in slowly from every side.

lines.zh: 她笑着退了一步，让开路。
lines.en: Smiling, she steps back and opens a path.
Her Blood Demon Art takes shape at her fingertips.

lines.zh: 网上的露水一颗颗颤动。
lines.en: Dew on the web shivers bead by bead.
Wrap you up tight!
Savor your bite.
You can't escape, Demon Slayer.
Show yourself under the sun!
Stop hiding, taste my venom!
My web will trap you.
Poisonous kiss in shadows.

lines.zh: 破晓前的最后一次攻击！
lines.en: Final attack before dawn.
My nails are finer than my threads.

lines.zh: 吞噬你的灵魂，回归蜘蛛山！
lines.en: Devour your soul, back to Spider Mountain.
White silk binds your wrist!

lines.zh: 她从上方落下，指甲划过！
lines.en: She drops from above, nails raking!

lines.zh: 我笑着，手指已经抬起来。
lines.en: I smile, but my fingers are already raised.
Spider Mountain, my home!

lines.zh: 阳光还亮，我先缩进阴影。
lines.en: The sun is still bright; I shrink into the shade first.
Watch out, Demon Slayer!

lines.zh: 我的毒液能致你于死地！
lines.en: My venom will kill you!
I'm the hunter in the shadows.

lines.zh: 蜘蛛山的丝，从我指尖开始。
lines.en: The mountain's silk starts at my fingertips.

lines.zh: 这里是我的领地，滚回去！
lines.en: This is my territory, get lost!
My venomous thread, a deadly strike!

lines.zh: 丝线从我指尖垂到地上。
lines.en: Threads hang from my fingertips to the ground.

lines.zh: 细弱了，快点杀了我，被火烧的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Weak now, kill me fast! — and the fire makes it worse.

lines.zh: 我快撑不住了，摔落的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: I can't hold on anymore! — and the fall makes it worse.

lines.zh: 求求你别杀我，溺水的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Please, don't kill me! — and the drown makes it worse.

lines.zh: 快救救我，遭爆炸的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Save me! — and the explosion makes it worse.

lines.zh: 再不动手我就完了，中箭的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Move or I'm done for! — and the projectile makes it worse.

lines.zh: 不要过来，别过来，中魔法的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Don't come any closer! — and the magic makes it worse.

lines.zh: 饶了我吧，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Have mercy on me! — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 别杀我，求求你，遭雷击的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Don't kill me, please! — and the lightning makes it worse.

lines.zh: 救救我，我还想活，坠入虚空的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: Save me, I want to live! — and the void makes it worse.
